name: Otonari-san Oyako to Ama Ama Harem Life ~Makabe-san Chi to In'etsu Paradise~
original_name: お隣さん母娘と甘々ハーレムライフ～真壁さんちと淫悦パラダイス～
source:
The protagonist, Yasuhira Sasamoto, was looking forward to his father's one-month business trip overseas.
The timing of the trip was fortunate — it started right after summer vacation began.
He thought spending summer vacation abroad would be a valuable experience.
However, as the vacation approached, he became increasingly anxious about language barriers, cultural differences, and safety concerns.
Eventually, he grew so nervous that he threw a tantrum and declared he didn't want to go at all.

At that time, the Makabe family — neighbors with whom they had a close familial relationship — offered to take Yasuhira in during his father’s absence.
Mitsuya "Obasan" (Auntie), who loved him like her own child.
Yuzuki "Oneechan" (Big Sister), who always treated him so kindly.
As Yasuhira begins living under the same roof as them, a faintly sweet, rosy aroma fills the air...
What will become of Yasuhira when faced with the crisis of losing control — both mentally and physically!?
translation:
主人公笹本泰平期待着父亲为期一个月的海外出差。
这次旅行的时机很幸运——暑假刚开始就开始了。
他认为在国外度过暑假将是一次宝贵的经历。
然而，随着假期的临近，他对语言障碍、文化差异和安全问题越来越感到焦虑。
最终，他变得非常紧张，大发脾气并宣布他根本不想去。

当时，与他们关系密切的真壁家提出在父亲不在期间收留安平。
Mitsuya“Obasan”（阿姨），像爱自己的孩子一样爱他。
总是对他如此友善的柚木“姐姐”（姐姐）。
当安平开始与他们生活在同一屋檐下时，空气中弥漫着淡淡的玫瑰香……
当面临精神和身体失控的危机时，安平会变成什么样子！？
